national.change: New Declaration Form (Annexure D) made mandatory alongside Form 6 (new elector) and Form 8 (shifting from outside Bihar); EROs to collect it also for pending Form 6 and advance claims w.r.t. 01.10.2025.

Guidelines 5(d): 'Every claim for inclusion of name in the roll as new elector shall be in Form-6 along with new Declaration Form.'

national.change: Only electors whose Enumeration Forms are received are put in the draft roll; others may file Form 6 with the Declaration during claims and objections.

national.change: No deletion from the draft roll without inquiry and a fair opportunity; first appeal to the District Magistrate (s.24(a) RPA 1950 r/w rule 27 RER 1960), second appeal to the CEO within 30 days (s.24(b)). national.document: Order No.23/ERS/2025, para 14; Guidelines para 5

Guidelines 5: 'In each such case, ERO/AERO shall pass a speaking order. Also, EROs will refer cases of suspected foreign nationals to the competent authority under the Citizenship Act, 1955.'
